products.name: PyTorch
products.note: Deep learning framework; model checkpoint governance; TorchServe deployment; research-to-production lineage

profile_text.body:
PyTorch is an open source deep learning framework governed by the PyTorch Foundation, which describes itself as the deep learning community home for the PyTorch framework and ecosystem. The foundation operates as a collaborative body under that umbrella and the project is associated with both Meta and the Linux Foundation.

The primary product tracked for this entity is PyTorch itself, which covers deep learning model development, model checkpoint governance, deployment via TorchServe, and research-to-production workflows. The ecosystem also includes Captum, an open source library for model interpretability built on PyTorch, with its name described as meaning "comprehension" in Latin. Meta has introduced Muse Glimmer, an open-weight 30-billion-parameter model distilled from Meta's Muse Spark and designed for on-device agentic workflows, with ExecuTorch adding end-to-end support for running Muse Glimmer on NVIDIA hardware.

The held facts confirm an active profile page for this entity and list PyTorch under the open source and self-hosted models category. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are present in the available data.
